description: This file defines the main page component for the 'Explore Roles' feature in a Next.js frontend application. It manages state for search queries, filters, loading states, and displays role cards with filtering, searching, and UI interactions.

methods.name: filterRoles
methods.description: Filters the list of roles based on current search query, selected filters, and salary range.

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.description: Triggers the search action, updating filtered roles based on current filters with a simulated delay.
